# Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Jean-Baptiste Alayrac, Jeff Donahue, Pauline Luc, Antoine Miech, Iain Barr, Yana Hasson, Karel Lenc, et al.  
**Year:** 2022  
**Journal:** NeurIPS  
**DOI:** [10.48550/arXiv.2204.14198](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2204.14198)  
**Publisher:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.14198](https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.14198)

**Keywords:** flamingo, visual language model

## Abstract

We introduce Flamingo a family of Visual Language Models that can bridge pretrained vision-only and language-only models.
